notes: Inputs copied from the pilot. Marketplace: salesEnabled = Gross Bookings − revenue. In gross (principal) markets and Freight the fare is in both Gross Bookings and revenue and nets to zero, and driver pay is counted once, through paidOut; in agent markets driver earnings sit outside revenue and are counted once, through salesEnabled. Gross Bookings include taxes, tolls and fees and are before consumer discounts (overstates). Single-year paidOut is about 7% below the accrual cross-check because accrued insurance reserves rose 2.82bn inside operating cash flow.
